stats.notes: No Common Data Set found: RISD does not post one (its Institutional Effectiveness page lists only a Tableau fact book, archived fact books to 2016 and accreditation reports), so these are IPEDS figures for the fall 2024 entering class: 6,692 applied, 1,249 admitted, 518 enrolled full-time (IPEDS ADM2024 counts via the Urban Institute Education Data Portal; College Navigator shows the same 6,692 applicants, 19% admitted and 41% of admitted students enrolled). Residency (in-state / international), early decision, waitlist, GPA and admission-factor figures are CDS-only items and are left blank. SAT/ACT percentiles are for enrolled first-time students who submitted scores (80 students = 15% sent SAT, 17 = 3% sent ACT); RISD is test-optional. College Navigator gives no combined SAT total. Undergraduate enrollment (2,087) and the nonresident-alien undergraduate count (692) are IPEDS fall 2024 (EF2024) totals; the 8-to-1 student-to-faculty ratio is College Navigator's. The calendar is semester (RISD's registrar lists a Fall semester, a Wintersession and a Spring semester).
